what: Response length as a predictor of human preference, before and after the split was length-balanced.
why: The first cut of pref-reward-model measured length and not preference. These are the numbers that showed it, recorded here so the figure and the write-up read the same source instead of restating prose.
metric: longer-wins: fraction of pairs where the preferred response is the longer one, ties counted as half. A model that has only learned length scores exactly this.
measured_by: research/posttrain/make_splits.py (balance_length) + direct character counts over the split files

unbalanced.note: natural sample of Anthropic/hh-rlhf, 1,000 held-out pairs per eval set

balanced.note: equal counts of longer-chosen and shorter-chosen pairs, ties dropped, applied to the training file and every holdout. 0.5000 holds by construction, not approximately.
